summary: Cortland County, NY tower on Morgan Hill near Truxton; built 1941 (Wikipedia says 1940), last lookout use 1970, removed by 1978; cabin moved to private land in 2025.

facts.design: International Derrick model 1937, 82 ft 6 in steel tower (Starr list)
facts.status_note: Removed; Wikipedia says removed in 1978 and the Starr list marks it removed. The former observer's cabin was moved to private land in 2025.
facts.agency: New York State Conservation Department / DEC (Starr list); built by CCC Camp S-103 of DeRuyter (Wikipedia)

access.note: Wikipedia says much or all of the hill, including its summit, lies within Morgan Hill State Forest, but the sentence carries a citation-needed tag. No source read describes current access to the summit.

visit.trail_note: No tower remains to climb; the tower was removed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Starr list and the July 1941 newspaper give 1941. Wikipedia gives 1940 for construction by CCC Camp S-103. The story uses 1941 and says the sources differ.
The Starr list gives 82 ft 6 in and Wikipedia gives 82.5 ft (25.1 m). The 1941 newspaper gives 82 feet. The record uses 25.1 m.

notes_for_editor: Built year is 1941 per the Starr list and the 1941 newspaper; Wikipedia gives 1940, and its 1978 removal date rests on Wikipedia alone (it cites the NYS FFLA list, which was not read). The Labrador Unique Area origin of the cabin is not in any source read, so it is left out of the story. A chapter Facebook post (search snippet only, not fetched) mentions closure by DEC in 1970 for Morgan Hill and Georgetown; not used. Access is weakly supported: the only source is a Wikipedia line about state forest land that carries a citation-needed tag. No photo added: none with a known license was found. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the story now says much or all of the hill (Wikipedia's wording), not most, and the museum and staffing wording follows the 2025 annual report.
